_comment: Reference / test fixture for the answer syntax that js/richContent.js understands. Not fetched by the app at runtime — the live chat calls the API in js/config.js (API_URL). Keep this file in sync with the backend's supported syntax as it grows, and use it to sanity-check new answer formatting by hand or in a small test harness.
